{{Infobox/Character |abiphone = Yes |location = [[The Forge]] |location_page_description = Allows the player to access {{Zone|The Forge}} after obtaining their [[Abiphone]] contact. |x = -2.5 |y = 148 |z = -68.5 }} '''Fred''' is an [[NPC]] in {{zone|The Forge}}. == Purpose == '''Fred''' can be given {{Item|Foul Flesh|amount=64}} in return for their [[Abiphone]] contact. Their contact opens the [[The Forge/UI|Forge Menu]]. == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" | Condition !Dialogue |- | colspan="2" class="ct" | None |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] Fred&f: These forges have been running at an endermite's pace! &e[NPC] Fred&f: My job here is to make sure the lava flows and that the titanium shines. &e[NPC] Fred&f: Yep, it's mostly watching other people work! }} |- | class="ct" rowspan="4" | [[Abiphones#Contacts|{{Aqua|Abiphone Contact}}]] | class="ct" | None |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] Fred&f: &b✆ &fErr, are you sure? &e[NPC] Fred&f: &b✆ &fThe signal doesn't work too well around here, but suit yourself. &e[NPC] Fred&f: &b✆ &fCould definitely use some help, if you are willing to trade. &e[NPC] Fred&f: &b✆ &fThe Forge doesn't charge users for its fuel, but we're using a mountain of it every day. &e[NPC] Fred&f: &b✆ &fI'm a little ashamed to admit it, but we mostly use &9Foul Flesh &fnowadays. &e[NPC] Fred&f: &b✆ &fWe tried a bunch of things but that's been working the best so far. &e[NPC] Fred&f: &b✆ &fFor a stack of &9Foul Flesh&f, I'll give you my personal contact. &a&l[GIVE ITEM] }} |- | class="ct" | Not Meeting Requirements |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Fred&f: &b✆ &fYou don't have what I need! {{DG|Without completing [[9f™ Network|{{DG|9f™ Network}}]]}} |- |(no dialogue, forge menu opens) |- |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Fred&f: &b✆ &fI can't really hear you right now, the signal is really bad!}}[1] |- |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Fred&f: &b✆ &fI'm not interested in extending my anvil warranty.}}[1] |- |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Fred&f: &b✆ &fYou're breaking up, I CAN'T HEAR YOU!}}[1] |- |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Fred&f: &b✆ &fWhat are you saying, the forge is in the omelette???}}[1] |- |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Fred&f: &b✆ &fAll I hear is crackling, the signal is really bad down here.}}[1] |} [1] The above dialogue lines will appear with some (randomly chosen) characters unintelligible, for example: {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Fred&f: &b✆ &fWh&ka&ft are y&ko&fu sa&ky&f&ki&fng&k,&f the &kf&forg&ke&f is in the omelette?&k?&f?}} == Trivia == *{{Rmt|&bForge Foreman}} is displayed above '''Fred'''{{'}}s head. *'''Fred''' is mentioned in the description of the {{Item|Skeleton Keychain}}. == Bugs == * '''Fred''' is currently bugged to not call the player when an item is done forging. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2022/Oct 13|[[File:Fred.png|26px]] Added '''Fred'''.}} {{History|2024/July 31|'''Fred''' will no longer complain about the signal after all the [[9f™ Network]] relays have been repaired.}} |beta= {{History|0.16|[[File:Fred.png|26px]] Added '''Fred'''.}} {{History|0.20.5|'''Fred''' will no longer complain about the signal after all the [[9f™ Network]] relays have been repaired.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}}
